gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-kadwa: Expressive and widely spaced, Bushcraft keeps its capitals hardly taller than lowercase. Kadwa, a text serif, handles the actual reading, its curves open-ended and its x-height unusually large, while Bushcraft just makes an entrance.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-piazzolla: Bushcraft spaces its letters wide, with capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Piazzolla, a serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose e is pried open, would carry paragraphs with refined authority.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-pridi: Bushcraft stretches its letters far apart and holds every curve to a single thickness, capitals barely above the lowercase. Bushcraft announces; Pridi, a text serif, reads, its small letters standing proud.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px, a text serif, reads dignified and bookish, with clear openings. Beneath Bushcraft's neon-tube lettering, bent to constant thickness and spaced wide, Slabo's large counters give the eye somewhere to rest.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-suwannaphum: Bushcraft spaces its letters wide and keeps every curve at constant weight. Suwannaphum, a serif with a wide-open c and a high, squared-off x-height, feels dignified and editorial beside that closed, artistic lettering.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-inter: Inter, a sans-serif, has hollow-reed counters and a smooth, tube-like line. Bushcraft's closed, widely spaced letters give the heading its swagger, and Inter lets the text breathe beneath it.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-roboto-slab: Bushcraft draws its o like a ring with a constant wall. Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with open-throated a, c, e and s and a dominant middle zone, would read precise and structured paragraph after paragraph.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-rubik: Bushcraft stretches its letters apart, drawing each line in a ruler-straight, constant width with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Bushcraft makes statements; Rubik, a soft sans with open round letters, reads.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-bespoke-sans: Capture It stands tall, nearly sealed and uniform in stroke. Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif with generous space between curve ends and stems, gives that towering heading a refined counterweight.
gen-dafont-capture-it-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads clean and modern, its c ends pointing apart like pincers and its stroke weight never wavering. Capture It towers and commands; Instrument Sans simply informs.
